# CoBible

> CoBible is a cross-platform Bible reading and study app (English and Russian). It combines the Bible text, audio chapters, AI-generated chapter study questions (Gemini AI), reading plans, streaks and optional Google Drive sync.

## Pages
- [English site](/): features, installation, FAQ
- [Русская версия](/ru): возможности, установка, вопросы

## Platforms
Planned: Google Play (Android), APK (Android), Windows, macOS, then App Store (iPhone/iPad). Download links are not yet published.
